items.title: Open Bible with a Wooden Cross
items.alt: A wooden cross rests on the blank cream pages of an open blue-covered Bible with a red ribbon bookmark.
items.description: Thick layered page edges and two pointed ribbon tails frame the simple devotional still life.

items.title: Child Decorating a Prayer Box
items.alt: A curly-haired cartoon child in yellow glasses decorates a wooden cross-marked box on a small stool.
items.description: A denim apron, star cutouts, blue scissors and a glue bottle distinguish the hands-on craft scene.

items.title: Older Woman Praying Beside Violets
items.alt: A smiling cartoon older woman with a silver bun and oval glasses stands with clasped hands beside a pot of purple flowers.
items.description: Her teal cardigan, long floral skirt and brown ankle boots create a complete, distinct standing character.

items.title: Blessings Dove with an Olive Branch
items.alt: A white dove with raised wings carries an olive branch above a gold “BLESSINGS” ribbon.
items.description: Layered flight feathers, tucked pink feet and green olives give the complete bird clear detail against the open background.

items.title: Blessings Envelope with Hearts and Open Hands
items.alt: Two open hands support an envelope marked “BLESSINGS” as red and pink hearts rise above it.
items.description: Blue and pink knitted cuffs frame the cream envelope, which closes with a red heart-shaped wax seal.

items.title: Little Angel Playing a Gold Harp
items.alt: A curly-haired cartoon angel in a cream robe holds a small gold harp with both hands.
items.description: Soft feathered wings, a star hair clip and bare feet frame the smiling fantasy character’s full figure.
